Meet Steve

Every restaurant has a story.
The numbers simply tell it.

Independent restaurants are among the most demanding businesses in the world to build. Every day owners make hundreds of decisions that determine whether their business grows, struggles, or thrives.

For more than twenty-five years, I’ve had the privilege of helping owners navigate those decisions.

Not from theory. From real businesses. Real restaurants. Real conversations.

BETTER DECISIONSstart with better information.
INDEPENDENT RESTAURANTSdeserve enterprise-level financial intelligence.
COMPLEX NUMBERSshould be simple to understand.
EVERY RECOMMENDATIONshould be practical enough to use tomorrow.

Founder & Partner

Schofer Dillberg & Company, Inc.

I’m a founding partner of Schofer Dillberg & Company, a boutique CPA and advisory firm specializing in restaurants, hospitality, and high-net-worth individuals.

Our firm believes exceptional advice comes from understanding the business behind the numbers, not simply preparing tax returns or financial statements.

Every engagement begins with one question:

“How can we help this business become stronger?”

Why I Started Full Plate Intelligence

Over the years I noticed a pattern. The same questions kept coming up.

Why isn’t there any cash left?
Can I afford another location?
Is my labor too high?
Should I renegotiate my lease?
How do I compare to restaurants like mine?

The answers existed. They just weren’t accessible.

Large restaurant groups have teams of analysts, CFOs, benchmarking data, and sophisticated reporting. Independent operators rarely do.

Full Plate Intelligence was created to change that.

My goal is to give independent restaurant owners access to practical financial intelligence: through weekly insights, benchmarking, conversations with industry leaders, and tools that help them make better decisions with confidence.

What I Help Restaurants Do

  • Restaurant consulting & operational strategy
  • Financial reporting & close process
  • Tax compliance & proactive tax planning
  • Cash flow optimization
  • Restaurant benchmarking & KPIs
  • Investor & lender relations
  • Financial forecasting & scenario planning
  • Lease negotiations & occupancy strategy
  • Acquisitions & transaction advisory
  • Succession planning & ownership transitions

When I’m Not at the Office

I’m a husband to Nicole and proud dad to our three girls: Delaney, Isla, and Nora.

They remind me every day that the best businesses aren’t built to consume our lives. They’re built to support them.

My Philosophy

The numbers aren’t the goal. They’re the roadmap. Every plate tells a financial story. My job is helping restaurant owners understand it.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 13, 2026

Who we are

Full Plate Intelligence provides insights, benchmarking, and practical strategies for independent restaurant owners, including our email newsletter, Full Plate Weekly.

What we collect

When you sign up for Full Plate Weekly, we collect the email address you provide. We also record which signup form on our website you used (for example, the homepage or the Meet Steve page) so we can understand how people find us. Our website does not ask for any other personal information at signup.

Like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically log basic technical information such as IP addresses and browser types for security and operational purposes.

How we use your information

We use your email address to send you Full Plate Weekly and other Full Plate Intelligence communications, such as updates about our upcoming shows, reports, and tools. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link included in every email, or by contacting us directly.

Email service provider

We use Kit (kit.com), an email service provider, to manage our mailing list and send our emails. When you subscribe, your email address is stored and processed by Kit on our behalf, subject to Kit's own privacy policy and terms.

Sharing

We do not sell your email address. We share it only with service providers (such as Kit) that help us operate our mailing list and website.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe at any time via the link in any of our emails. If you would like your email address removed from our list entirely, contact us at Steve@FullPlateIntel.com and we will take care of it.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time as Full Plate Intelligence grows. The latest version will always be posted on this page.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Email us at Steve@FullPlateIntel.com.

Our site and emails may link to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

Changes
